;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[Syrian Civil War]]
**The [[Kurds in Syria|Kurdish]]-led [[Syrian Democratic Forces]] seize control of [[Hajin]], the last major town held by [[Islamic State of Iraq and the Levant|ISIL]] in [[Syria]], according to the [[Syrian Observatory for Human Rights]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2018/dec/14/kurdish-led-fighters-take-last-isis-town-in-syria-activists-say (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2018 Strasbourg attack]]
**An [[Italians|Italian]] [[journalist]] to the [[European Parliament]] who was wounded during a terrorist attack in [[Strasbourg]], [[France]], dies of his injuries, raising the death toll to four. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-france-security-victim/fourth-victim-of-strasbourg-market-attack-dies-prosecutor-idUSKBN1OD1VP (Reuters)]
*Six government officials are killed and 14 others are wounded in an attack in [[Balochistan, Pakistan|Balochistan]], [[Pakistan]]. The [[Balochistan Liberation Army|BLA]] claims responsibility. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2018/12/security-officials-killed-attack-southwest-pakistan-181214142845561.html (Al Jazeera)] 

;Business and economy
*American [[Conservatism in the United States|conservative]] weekly opinion magazine ''[[The Weekly Standard]]'' announces that it will shut down this month after 23 years in print. [https://edition.cnn.com/2018/12/14/media/weekly-standard-end/index.html (CNN)]

;Law and crime
*On the sixth anniversary of the [[Sandy Hook Elementary School shooting|Sandy Hook shooting]], the school is evacuated due to a [[bomb threat]]. It is not believed to be connected with the [[2018 Bitcoin bomb threats]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2018/12/14/us/sandy-hook-evacuated-threat/index.html (CNN)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Military of Kosovo]]
**The [[Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo]] votes to create a proper army out of the lightly-armed [[Kosovo Security Force]], with eleven [[Kosovo Serbs|minority Serb]] deputies boycotting the vote. While the [[United States]] lauds the decision, criticism has come from both [[NATO]] and the neighbouring country of [[Serbia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/us-kosovo-army/kosovo-approves-new-army-despite-serb-opposition-nato-criticism-idUSKBN1OD16S (Reuters)]
*[[First cabinet of Donald Trump|Cabinet of Donald Trump]]
**President Donald Trump appoints incumbent [[Office of Management and Budget]] director [[Mick Mulvaney]] as Acting [[White House Chief of Staff]], to replace [[John F. Kelly]] at the end of the year. [https://www.npr.org/2018/12/14/676954720/trump-announces-mick-mulvaney-as-acting-white-house-chief-of-staff (NPR)]
